_doc: Bolt & Sprocket gadgets (BS_LEVELS §0.5). Ownership is BS flag 'gadget.<id>'; GadgetManager.attach_to(bolt) adds the owned ones to Bolt and routes the 'gadget' input action (K / D-pad down) to the primary gadget. Every tuning number lives here. Lines under 'lines' are registered into VOManager by GadgetManager (add 'bs/gadgets' / 'lines' to VOManager.LINE_SOURCES).

tether_hook.name: TETHER-HOOK
tether_hook._src: BS_LEVELS §0.5 / §3.5 (new; not in the web build)
tether_hook._pull: a pull reels to ring + land_offset (on the approach side of the lip, a little above), then mantles: up to mantle_up above the ring, in mantle_in past it (toward the ledge), and steps off at mantle_exit_speed. A ring whose land_offset has no sideways part ends in a pull_hop / pull_hop_forward hop instead.

bs.gadget.tether.how.text: TETHER-HOOK: look at an ORANGE ring and press K / D-pad down to swing. GREEN rings reel you in. Press again or JUMP to let go.

bs.gadget.tether.no_target.text: No ring in range. Look straight at an orange or green cable ring.

bs.gadget.tether.weight.01.text: For the record, my weight limit is one mechanic. ONE. You've been eating.

bs.gadget.tether.weight.02.text: I am a load-bearing toaster now. Put that on my résumé.

bs.gadget.tether.weight.03.text: Swing gently. My warranty does not cover being a pendulum.

bs.gadget.tether.weight.04.text: Holding. Holding. My arms are ninety percent servo and ten percent spite.

bs.gadget.tether.pull.01.text: Reeling! Tuck your knees, this ring was rated for ore carts.
